# Practice website review checklist

Reusable blank worksheet for reviewing a GP practice website. For England GMS checks, use the official [GMS Regulations 2015, regulation 73](https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/1862/regulation/73), [regulation 78](https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/1862/regulation/78), and [Schedule 3, Part 6, paragraph 48](https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/1862/schedule/3/paragraph/48). This worksheet supports evidence gathering and review; completing it does not itself establish legal compliance, clinical safety, accessibility conformance, DPO approval, or practice sign-off.

## Review record

| Field                          | Entry |
| ------------------------------ | ----- |
| Practice name                  |       |
| Nation                         |       |
| Contract route and version     |       |
| Website/profile address        |       |
| Reviewer                       |       |
| Review date                    |       |
| Sources checked through (date) |       |
| Next review due                |       |
| Practice source owner/reviewer |       |

## How to use this worksheet

For each row, record a specific evidence location or source, the check performed, and any follow-up. For conditional items, establish applicability from authoritative practice or contract records and give the reason if not applicable. Keep patient-facing content and internal evidence separate. Do not fill gaps with assumptions. A page existing or a build passing is not evidence that its facts are correct.

Use a status only after review: **Code/content evidenced** (the stated material is present; this is not a compliance finding), **Practice/manual verification required**, **Gap**, or **Not applicable** (give reason). Leave status blank until assessed. Automated checks cannot establish accuracy, prominence, legal applicability, or accessibility conformance. Record manual and runtime work still outstanding.

## England GMS applicability note

This checklist summarizes England GMS requirements. Identify the nation and contract route before applying it; do not use it as a blanket statement about PMS, APMS or Welsh arrangements. Record applicability and source context in the review record rather than as scored checklist rows.

## Practice leaflet: Schedule 3 Part 6 paragraph 48

A practice leaflet is the document the contractor must compile under regulation 78, review at least every 12 months, keep accurate and make available to patients and prospective patients. GMS-73-2 is the parent website-publication check: confirm each applicable paragraph 48 item appears as ordinary web content; the rows below are its individually assessed subchecks. Check each topic against the current full wording. Conditional topics require an applicability decision and reason.

| ID            | Requirement / review question                                                                                                                                                                            | Evidence source and location | Status | Check performed / result | Owner and next action |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------ | --------------------- |
| LEAFLET-48-A  | Name of the contractor.                                                                                                                                                                                  |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-B  | Address of each practice premises.                                                                                                                                                                       |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-C  | Contractor telephone and fax number and website address or online practice profile address.                                                                                                              |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-D  | If the contract is with a partnership: whether it is a limited partnership and the names of all partners, with general/limited status where applicable.                                                  |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-E  | If the contract is with a company limited by shares: names of directors, company secretary and shareholders, and registered office address.                                                              |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-F  | Full name of each person performing services under the contract.                                                                                                                                         |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-G  | Professional qualifications of each health care professional providing services under the contract.                                                                                                      |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-H  | Whether the contractor undertakes teaching or training of health care professionals or people intending to become health care professionals.                                                             |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-I  | Practice area, including outer-boundary area, represented by an image, written description or digital practice area map.                                                                                 |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-J  | Disabled access arrangements at practice premises, or alternative arrangements if there are none.                                                                                                        |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-K  | How to register as a patient.                                                                                                                                                                            |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-L  | Information about assignment of an accountable GP to new and existing patients.                                                                                                                          |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-M  | Information about assignment of an accountable GP to patients aged 75 and over.                                                                                                                          |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-N  | Patient’s right to express a practitioner preference and how to do so.                                                                                                                                   |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-O  | Services available under the contract.                                                                                                                                                                   |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-P  | Practice premises opening hours and all means of contacting the contractor throughout core hours, as required by Schedule 3 paragraph 4.                                                                 |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-Q  | Home-visit criteria and how to obtain a visit.                                                                                                                                                           |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-R  | Consultations available under paragraphs 9 and 10.                                                                                                                                                       |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-S  | Out-of-hours arrangements and how patients may access them.                                                                                                                                              |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-T  | If out-of-hours services are not provided by the contractor, state that NHS England is responsible for commissioning them.                                                                               |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-U  | How patients may obtain repeat prescriptions.                                                                                                                                                            |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-V  | If repeatable prescribing is offered, its arrangements.                                                                                                                                                  |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-W  | If the contractor is a dispensing contractor, its dispensing arrangements.                                                                                                                               |                              |        |                          |                       |
| LEAFLET-48-X  | How patients may make a complaint or comment about services.                                                                                                                                             |                              |        |                          |                       |

| --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------ | --------------------- |
| GMS-73-3  | Online information is reviewed at least once in each 12-month period, updated as needed, and updated when a premises address, telephone number, displayed email address or another stated appointment/repeat-prescription contact method changes.                                |                              |        |                          |                       |
| GMS-73-4  | The homepage or equivalent has prominent links to the practice online consultation tool, NHS symptom-checker and self-care information, and NHS England’s General Practice Patient Guidance (“You and Your General Practice”). Destinations are provider-maintained and working. |                              |        |                          |                       |
| GMS-73-5A | The homepage/equivalent links to the required online consultation, NHS symptom-checker/self-care and General Practice Patient Guidance destinations.                                                                                                                             |                              |        |                          |                       |
| GMS-73-5B | The required homepage links are prominent. Record regulation 73(5A)–(5B) separately from contract cross-references.                                                                                                                                                              |                              |        |                          |                       |

## Complaints information

| ID           | Requirement / review question                                                                                                                                                                           | Evidence source and location | Status | Check performed / result | Owner and next action |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------ | --------------------- |
| COMPLAINTS-1 | Practice complaints route is easy to find and local contact details and responsible handler are verified.                                                                                               |                              |        |                          |                       |
| COMPLAINTS-2 | Information explains verbal and written complaints and how a verbal complaint is recorded.                                                                                                              |                              |        |                          |                       |
| COMPLAINTS-3 | Information gives the usual 12-month period and accurately describes possible extension where there is good reason and a fair investigation remains possible.                                           |                              |        |                          |                       |
| COMPLAINTS-4 | Acknowledgement and an offer to discuss handling are described within 3 working days; expected response period is agreed, with no invented fixed response deadline.                                     |                              |        |                          |                       |
| COMPLAINTS-5 | Information explains updates if delayed and the written investigation response, findings, any appropriate apology/action, and escalation information.                                                   |                              |        |                          |                       |
| COMPLAINTS-6 | Provider or commissioner route is accurately explained; current commissioner and local details are verified. The complainant is allowed to choose a route without implying both may be pursued at once. |                              |        |                          |                       |
| COMPLAINTS-7 | Advocacy/support and complaints made on another person’s behalf are covered accurately, including when consent or capacity needs consideration.                                                         |                              |        |                          |                       |
| COMPLAINTS-8 | End-of-local-resolution information accurately describes escalation to the Public Service Ombudsman, with current eligibility and time-limit wording checked against its guidance.                      |                              |        |                          |                       |
| COMPLAINTS-9 | Local process is checked against regulation 79 and the current NHS Complaints Regulations and guidance.                                                                                                 |                              |        |                          |                       |

| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------ | --------------------- |
| ACCESSIBILITY-1 | Identify applicable legal accessibility duties and current NHS guidance for this service; do not imply a WCAG version applies universally without support.                                                    |                              |        |                          |                       |
| ACCESSIBILITY-2 | Record WCAG 2.2 AA as the project assessment baseline in line with current NHS guidance. Identify any historical subset of checks and the evidence still needed for a conformance assessment.                 |                              |        |                          |                       |
| ACCESSIBILITY-3 | Automated checks, rendered-page inspection, keyboard use, screen-reader behavior, mobile layout, prominence and plain-language review are recorded separately; outstanding manual/runtime checks remain open. |                              |        |                          |                       |
| PRIVACY-1       | Confirm the current source and applicability for privacy information and any related duties; record DPO/source review where applicable.                                                                       |                              |        |                          |                       |
| OTHER-1         | Confirm official source and applicability for any other claimed publication duty, including accessibility statement or CQC information; do not infer a contractual/statutory duty from an existing page.      |                              |        |                          |                       |
